title: Blackberry Crisp
description: A simple dessert featuring fresh blackberries topped with a crunchy oat mixture. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the blackberries and granulated sugar.
Transfer the blackberry mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In another bowl, mix together the flour, oats, brown sugar, and salt.
Add the cold butter to the dry ingredients and mix until crumbly.
Spread the oat mixture evenly over the blackberry filling.
Bake for 40-45 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is tender.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
